issues.title: Unused join to user_profiles
issues.explanation: No column from p is selected or filtered on. Being one-to-one it does not change the counts, but it is extra work and makes readers wonder whether rows fan out.

issues.title: COUNT(DISTINCT) on a primary key
issues.explanation: u.id is unique and nothing fans out, so DISTINCT only adds a sort per group.

issues.title: Ordinal GROUP BY / ORDER BY
issues.explanation: Positional references silently change meaning if someone reorders or adds a column in the SELECT list.
issues.fix: Group and order by the expressions or aliases (week_start, channel, signups).
